title: Plugins: floating-pane TUI to manage herdr plugins
description: Manage herdr plugins from inside herdr: list installed, toggle enabled/disabled, inspect, install. Bash + fzf in a placement=popup pane, mirroring cmc.iris.

title: Walking skeleton: manifest + popup pane opens
description: herdr-plugin.toml with id=cmc.plugins, one [[actions]] entry (open) and one [[panes]] entry (list, placement=popup, 80%x80%). open.sh re-execs via $HERDR_BIN_PATH like iris/open.sh does. install-deps.sh checks fzf is present and fails loudly if not. Done when the popup opens from a config.toml plugin_action binding and prints a hardcoded line.

title: Render installed plugins as fzf rows
description: Parse 'herdr plugin list' JSON envelope (result.plugins[]) into one row per plugin: enabled/disabled marker, plugin_id, name, source kind. Sort disabled first so what needs attention is at the top.

title: Toggle enabled/disabled without leaving the pane
description: fzf --bind on a key to run 'herdr plugin enable|disable' for the highlighted row, then reload the row source in place so the marker flips. Must not close the popup.

title: Preview pane: plugin detail
description: fzf --preview showing description, declared actions and events, plugin_root, version and min_herdr_version. Source: 'herdr plugin list --json' (NOT --format json, which plugin list rejects). Two things are NOT in that payload: the config dir needs 'herdr plugin config-dir <id>', and resolved_commit exists only when source.kind==github — local sources carry only 'kind', so the preview must not assume a commit.

title: Disable must reap the plugin's daemons
description: herdr plugin disable leaves already-spawned daemons running (confirmed on 0.8.0 — three claude-auto-retry monitors survived a disable). After disabling, find processes whose argv contains the plugin_root and terminate them, then report how many were reaped.

title: Install a plugin from the popup
description: Prompt for owner/repo[/subdir], run 'herdr plugin install <spec> -y', refresh the list. Report the resolved commit on success and the stderr line on failure.

title: Uninstall with a confirm step
description: Confirm by name, run 'herdr plugin uninstall <id>', refresh. Destructive, so require an explicit y rather than a single keypress on a highlighted row.

title: Verify whether enable/disable needs a server reload to take effect
description: Unknown that blocks the toggle being honest: does 'herdr plugin enable|disable' apply immediately, or does the server keep the old state until 'herdr server reload-config'? Test by toggling a cheap plugin and checking whether its events still fire. If a reload is needed, the toggle must run it.

title: Bind the popup to a key in dotfiles config.toml
description: Add a type=plugin_action binding for cmc.plugins.open to ~/Projects/personal/dotfiles/herdr/.config/herdr/config.toml. Lands in the dotfiles repo, not this one. Pick a key that does not collide: o, g, r, v, e, d, n, p, c, w are taken.

title: One runnable check for row rendering
description: Ponytail rule: non-trivial logic leaves one runnable check. Feed a committed fixture of 'herdr plugin list --json' into the row builder and assert the rendered lines. No framework, no fixtures dir sprawl — one script that exits nonzero on mismatch, like iris's test-frontmatter.sh.

title: Publish: LICENSE, topic, install line
description: Add LICENSE, push to GitHub, tag the repo with the herdr-plugin topic so it is discoverable, and put the 'herdr plugin install <owner>/herdr-plugin-manager' line in the README.
